keyword: where to watch the artemis 2 launch

verifications.claim: The Artemis II launch will be streamed live on NASA+.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Viewers can watch the event on NASA+, the space agency's free streaming service, starting at 12:50 p.m. ET.' R5: 'NASA+ (NASA’s free, no-subscription streaming service).'

verifications.claim: The Artemis II launch will be streamed live on the NASA YouTube channel.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'on its website, social media, and its YouTube channel.' R5: 'NASA official broadcast (YouTube and NASA+)'

verifications.claim: The Artemis II launch will be streamed live on the NASA website.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'NASA will stream the launch from Kennedy Space Center... on its website, social media, and its YouTube channel.'

verifications.claim: The Artemis II launch streaming starts with fuel tanking operations.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Live coverage of filling the rocket's tanks with fuel is expected to begin at 7:45 a.m. ET Wednesday on Youtube.' R5: 'The YouTube coverage begins Wednesday at 7:45 a.m. EDT with tanking operations'

verifications.claim: Coverage of the Artemis II launch is available on the NASA App.
verifications.label: OMITTED
verifications.reasoning: NASA app mentioned only for AROW tracking, not launch coverage.

verifications.claim: Coverage of the Artemis II launch is available on C-SPAN.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R5: 'C-SPAN’s all-day coverage begins at 1:00 p.m. EDT, featuring feeds from Kennedy Space Center and Mission Control'

verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission will feature live feeds from the Orion capsule throughout its 10-day journey.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R6: 'NASA plans to continue broadcasting live views of the Artemis II mission as the astronauts travel through space over the next 10 days.' R2: Multiple mentions of live feeds, screenshots from NASA during mission.
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm live views from Orion planned and provided throughout mission.

verifications.claim: NASA+, YouTube, and NASA TV offer continuous coverage from pre-launch to orbit insertion.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R5: 'YouTube coverage... runs continuously through the entire 10-day mission.' R1: Coverage on YouTube and NASA+ from tanking/pre-launch. No explicit 'NASA TV' or 'to orbit insertion.'
verifications.reasoning: Supports continuous on YouTube/NASA+, but NASA TV not specified; scope to orbit insertion broader than stated details.

verifications.claim: Participants can join the Virtual Guest Program via NASA's Eventbrite page.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R5: 'NASA’s Virtual Guest Program Register free on NASA’s Eventbrite page'

verifications.claim: Virtual Guest Program participants receive a commemorative digital passport.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R5: 'Registrants receive a commemorative digital passport with a stamp emailed after launch.'

verifications.claim: NASA's Artemis Real-time Orbit Website (AROW) allows following the Orion capsule in real-time.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R5: 'NASA’s Artemis Real-time Orbit Website (AROW) lets you follow Orion’s journey around the Moon as it happens, starting about one minute after liftoff.'

verifications.claim: CBS News will feature special coverage.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R7: 'CBS News will broadcast a Special Report with live coverage of the launch'

verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R5: 'CNN’s special coverage, titled “Mission to the Moon: Artemis II Launch,” begins Wednesday at 5:00 p.m. EDT'

verifications.claim: Spanish Language Coverage is available on NASA's Spanish YouTube channel.
verifications.label: OMITTED
verifications.reasoning: No mention of Spanish coverage or channel in any source.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew is traveling on a 10-day mission around the moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'roughly 10-day deep space excursion that will loop around Earth before slingshotting around the moon'. R2/R3/R5/R6: Repeatedly '10-day mission around the moon.'

verifications.claim: Artemis II marks the first human flight of the Space Launch System rocket.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Artemis II is a test flight of... Space Launch System rocket... follows Artemis I, the successful uncrewed inaugural voyage'. R5: 'first time humans have traveled beyond Earth orbit since Apollo 17'
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly first crewed after uncrewed test.

verifications.claim: Artemis II marks the first human flight of the Orion capsule.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'test flight of... Orion capsule... follows Artemis I, the successful uncrewed inaugural voyage of the spacecraft'. R2: 'first time... tested the system's life support systems'
verifications.reasoning: Confirmed as first crewed after uncrewed Artemis I.
